title: Polynomial-Time Computability of One Greatest Common Divisor Step
statement: For a bit string $S$, let $a$ and $b$ be the decoded first and second components, using the empty string when decoding fails. If $b$ represents zero, return $S$ unchanged; otherwise return the self-delimiting encoding of $b$ and the binary representation of $\operatorname{val}(a)\bmod\operatorname{val}(b)$. This function is computable in polynomial time by a finite Turing machine.
